verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships first-party AI-oriented primitives that give agent steps durability: durable multi-turn chat agents (chat.agent, one task per conversation surviving deploys and crashes), a `tool({ needsApproval: true })` pattern that pauses runs for human approval, prompt and model overrides without redeploying, and forwarding of streams from any AI provider. However, the evidence never names specific first-party wrappers for third-party AI SDKs, agent frameworks or model providers, so the 'no glue code' integration claim is only implied. Missing for 10: explicitly documented integrations with named AI SDKs, agent frameworks and model providers; evidence that existing agent code gets durability without adaptation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
